rule: Run published behavioral runtime-contract vectors in the real V8 isolate and assert SDK parity
origin: F2/F3, 2026-10-18; live relay webhook atob failure, 2026-10-20
why: Node WebCrypto hid missing isolate capabilities; Query/Reducer native clocks and randomness diverged from the intent
measurement: Measured warm cargo filtered real-isolate command plus Node SDK contract command: 70.304112s under shared-host load, including process/compile-slot startup; Rust case body 8.24s. Earlier measured warm combined command 0.34794s. 34 cases twice. No savings estimate.
retainedRules: No existing rule removed. This is a regression outcome suite for observed runtime failures, not a style rule.

rule: Publish staging SDKs only from the exact clean green staging SHA with coordinated prerelease versions
why: The existing stable release script pushes main; staging needs a separate prerelease publisher
measurement: Measured node --test scripts/release-staging.test.mjs including startup; rejects wrong SHA, stable versions, dirty state and failed/pending CI
retainedRules: No existing rule removed; this guards the authorized release boundary.

rule: Count visibility SQL, snapshots and principal rebuilds in real multi-member Replica Collection feed scenarios
origin: Whagons staging visibility fan-out incident, 2026-10-29; approvals.decideByTask pinned the Rust runtime for approximately 60 seconds
why: Data-table visibility sets and budgeted-source invalidation made an ordinary task write rerun visibility SQL across unrelated connections
measurement: Measured legacy-baseline plus v2 integration test body: 12.97s, excluding 36.57s compilation on this run. CI uses 200 members plus one duplicate connection. Legacy task insert/update/delete: 402/201/402 visibility SQL operations and full snapshots; v2: zero for each. Team grant: legacy 402 SQL/snapshots across all connections, v2 eight targeted fetches only for m1-m3. Membership change: four SQL/snapshots scoped to m1's two connections; v2 records four principal rebuilds, with cross-connection sharing explicitly deferred. Parent grant: legacy 402 SQL/snapshots, v2 two fetches for m0. Counters, not elapsed time, decide correctness. Tests: visibility_fanout_legacy_baseline and visibility_fanout_stays_within_statement_budgets in rust/crates/runtime/tests/visibility_fanout.rs; configure GONVEX_TEST_POSTGRES_URL, GONVEX_TEST_MODULE_HOST_BINARY and optionally GONVEX_VIS_FANOUT_MEMBERS.
retainedRules: No existing rule removed. Counts enforce the observed regression budget rather than wall-clock timing.
